verdict.rationale: The docs offer fast-start paths: a 'Get started with low-code Flow' guide, a Hosted Payment Page marketed as 'a fully branded checkout page in less than a day', and a public test account with test cards. Language support is thin, though: an official Node.js SDK is the only SDK evidenced, and no copy-paste code samples across languages are shown. The under-a-day claim is vendor marketing only, and the probe found no public OpenAPI spec to generate clients from. Missing for 10: evidenced copy-paste code samples in multiple languages, SDKs beyond Node.js and mobile, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a sub-day integration.
